editorial.blurb: Devil Dawgs delivers an authentic Chicago dog experience with snappy service and edgy, Instagram-worthy vibes in the heart of Andersonville.
editorial.insiderTip: Order at the kiosk for quick service, and aim for earlier in the day to avoid the rush—locals swear by their monthly visits for the perfectly made Chicago dog.

topDishes.note: perfectly executed with excellent relish, onions, and tomato; snap of the hot dog is on point
small but surprisingly filling and delicious
